name: Chacoan peccary
desc: A large wild pig of the dry Chaco that feeds heavily on cacti and other tough plants. Once thought extinct, it is now known from the Chaco.
about: The Chacoan peccary, also called the taguá, is a peccary found in the Gran Chaco of Paraguay, Bolivia, and Argentina. It is the only extant species of genus Catagonus.
